topic: What creates the Earth's magnetic field (and why does it move)?
author_requirements: Explain the geodynamo as coupled conducting-fluid induction, buoyancy, rotation, diffusion, and Lorentz feedback.
Separate internal secular variation from ionospheric, magnetospheric, lithospheric, oceanic, and instrument signals.
Include numbered mathematical equations and explain every symbol after each equation.
Include synthetic-twin identifiability, held-out forecast evaluation, baselines, ablations, and falsification.
Keep expected and observed results empty and do not claim a completed reconstruction or forecast.
Do not add an Acknowledgment/Acknowledgements section or other out-of-workflow material.
Treat the requested 8-page minimum as the revised 7-page minimum.
